text: What gave you even a little calm or joy today?
Which thought has kept coming back to you in recent days, and what would you like to do with it?
What can you thank yourself for today?
What small change could make your coming week more pleasant?
What have you learned recently, however small?
Which value matters to you, and how did it show up in your choices today?
If you had to describe this stage of your life with a single image, what would it be?
What do you want to give more attention to in the coming month?
Which custom from your family home do you like most, and why?
Which saying or proverb did you often hear in your family? What do you think of it today?
How does your family celebrate holidays? What would you like to keep, and what would you do your own way?
How was money talked about at home, if at all? How do you want to talk about it?
Which belief about work or duty did you take from home, and how far is it your own today?
What role do you usually play at family gatherings? Are you comfortable in it?
How would you like to express your boundaries with the people close to you, in a way that feels right to you?
Which family story or anecdote do you enjoy telling others?
Which dish, smell or song do you associate with home? What does it bring back?
Which quality or skill of someone in your family do you value and would like to develop in yourself?
Which family custom would you like to change or replace with a new one? What could it look like?
Which values, in your own words, do you want to pass on or nurture in the people around you?
How did your family show appreciation or joy? Which of those ways feel close to you?
If you feel like it: which conversation would you like to have one day with someone close to you, and what about?
Which image, colour or detail on the card you drew caught your attention first?
If the figure on the card could ask you one question, what would it be?
Which situation in your life does today's card remind you of?
If the card was reversed, what could it mean for you to look at its theme from the other side?
Which emotion did the card stir in you, and where might it come from?
What from this card's symbolism do you want to take with you for the rest of the day?
Which description in your number profile fits you best, and which fits you least? Why?
How do you understand the theme of your personal year, and what do you want to do with it in practice?
Did the reflection question for your life path bring back a memory? Describe it.
How does the way others see you differ from what you feel inside, and did the number descriptions help you name it?
If you could give yourself a number for this month, which would it be, and why?
